metadata.title: TrustBoost Comprehensive Academic Evaluation Audit

pii_leakage_audit.leakage_rate_definition: Entity Leakage Rate = (ground-truth entities remaining in sanitized output) / (total ground-truth entities). Occurs when contextual LLM fails to detect an entity (False Negative), allowing sensitive text to bypass tokenization.

robustness_audit.critical_finding: The previous robustness report evaluated only execution safety (pipeline did not crash and completed roundtrip). When evaluated against ground-truth annotations, actual detection F1 drops on structured tables (markdown cells missed), extended narratives (sub-clause names missed), and category mismatches (UPI ID classified as BANK_ACCOUNT).

performance_audit.warmup_procedure_documented: Cold start measures initial un-cached inference (6.81s). An un-timed warm-up run (3.87s) was executed to ensure weights reside in memory before benchmark timing.

tier_latencies_summary.large_455_words_status: 0/5 iterations succeeded (100% fail-closed rate under 3,774-character context)

performance_audit.prompt_length_asymmetry_explained: Multi-iteration empirical benchmarking across 5 iterations reveals: Small Text (74 words) averaged 28.20s (detecting 9.4 entities). Medium Text (261 words) averaged 154.67s (detecting 32.0 entities). Large Text (455 words, 3,774 chars) failed closed across all 5 iterations because the model failed to generate valid JSON under long multi-paragraph context. This provides empirical proof that local LLM contextual detection has an operational context boundary beyond which fail-closed rejection triggers.
performance_audit.sanitization_vs_llm_latency_ratio: Deterministic tokenization and restoration execute in sub-millisecond to 5.7ms (< 0.001% of pipeline latency).

category_coverage_audit.audit_explanation: The initial evaluation report displayed only 10 categories because only samples 001-020 were evaluated. Samples 001-020 only cover personal identification and Indian banking/financial identifiers. The remaining 14 categories (credentials, passwords, tokens, API keys, infrastructure URLs, IPs, confidential projects) are located in samples 021-055 and were omitted from the initial 20-sample run.

strict_fn_reconciliation.formula: Strict FNs (53) = Masked/Protected by Non-Strict Tokens (39) + Residual Verbatim Leaked Entities (14)

error_taxonomy_reconciliation.counting_level: Entity-level (171 gold, 159 pred) vs Error-event level (paired overlap instances).
error_taxonomy_reconciliation.reconciliation_proof: 6 Spurious Detections (6 FP, 0 FN) + 35 Overlapping Pairs (35 FP, 39 FN) + 14 Missed PII (0 FP, 14 FN) = 41 Strict FP and 53 Strict FN (94 total strict error points).

global_mapping_verification.within_same_streamlit_session_tab: VERIFIED (State preserved in st.session_state across user inputs)
global_mapping_verification.across_streamlit_script_reruns: VERIFIED (st.session_state persists across widget reruns in the same tab)
global_mapping_verification.across_separate_browser_sessions_or_tabs: REFUTED / NOT IMPLEMENTED (Streamlit creates isolated session_state per tab; no shared cross-session storage)
global_mapping_verification.across_application_restarts: REFUTED / NOT IMPLEMENTED (Global mapping is strictly in-memory RAM; zero disk/database persistence)

performance_benchmark_verification.output_tokens_status: HYPOTHESIS (Output token count eval_count was not directly logged; 32 vs 0 detected entities is empirical fact)
performance_benchmark_verification.benchmark_sample_size_limitation: Medium and Large tiers evaluated for n=1 iteration; run-to-run variance not statistically measurable.

verified_results: Dataset contains exactly 100 samples and 171 ground-truth entities with zero offset mismatches.
Deterministic tokenization and restoration operate in sub-millisecond to 2ms timeframes with zero leakage on detected entities.
Global token consistency and bijective mapping are 100% verified across repeated inputs within a session.
Fail-closed mechanisms correctly reject malformed JSON, truncated streams, negative offsets, and hallucinated types.
Negative sample specificity achieved 0 false positives on clean non-sensitive technical text.
Reconciliation of 53 strict False Negatives: exactly 39 were masked by non-strict tokens, and exactly 14 leaked verbatim.
Reconciliation of 94 strict error points (41 FP + 53 FN) with error taxonomy pairings.
Global mapping persistence verified within a single browser session/tab and across script reruns.
Measured raw benchmark latency, cold start (12.03s), and detected entity counts (9, 32, 0).
corrected_results: Evaluated sample count corrected from initial partial set to 100/100 samples.
PII Leakage Rate corrected from '0%' to 8.19% entity leakage due to model False Negatives.
Robustness evaluation corrected: Previous report measured pipeline execution survival; actual detection F1 across diverse styles is 0.7458.
Category metrics expanded to report on all 24 supported categories rather than the initial 10.
Global mapping persistence scope corrected: Clarified that mapping does NOT persist across separate browser tabs or application restarts.
Performance latency explanation corrected: Decoupled empirically measured facts (32 vs 0 entities detected) from the decoding length hypothesis (eval_count unlogged).
hypotheses: Decoding Latency Asymmetry: The hypothesis that Medium text was slower than Large text due to output token decoding length is consistent with the measured entity counts (32 vs 0) and transformer mechanics, but remains a hypothesis because raw token counts (eval_count) were not logged.
unverified_claims: Claim of 'Zero Leakage': Unverified and false when defined against ground-truth. Residual leakage occurs whenever the detector misses an entity (FN).
Persistence across multiple browser sessions: Refuted (not implemented in Streamlit session state).
Persistence across application restarts: Refuted (no database or disk serialization exists).
Exact output token counts during benchmark: Refuted as measured data; reclassified as a theoretical hypothesis.
failed_tests: PII Leakage: 14 ground-truth entities remained un-sanitized due to detection false negatives.
Robustness Table Detection: Detector missed tabular entity cells in Markdown syntax.
Robustness Slang Detection: UPI VPA misclassified as BANK_ACCOUNT in informal chat.
limitations: Local Gemma 3 4B inference speed on CPU/unified memory is ~5-15s per short sentence and up to ~200s on dense multi-entity paragraphs.
Autoregressive decoding time is dominated by output JSON token count, creating latency asymmetry between dense and sparse samples.
Multi-word address boundaries exhibit occasional truncation (boundary errors).
Contextual detection alone without fallback dictionary/rules is susceptible to subtle typos in informal messaging.
Global mapping state is strictly transient in-memory RAM and resets on page reload, tab close, or server restart.
Performance benchmarks for Medium and Large tiers reflect single-run observations (n=1) without statistical confidence intervals.
